board: M5Stack Unit Mini IMU (U095, MPU6886), HY2.0-4P socket: GND, 5V, SDA, SCL
reason: Check PASS on first run (ESP32 and Pico: spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator test, PCB DRC clean, footprint). The sim encodes the 14 bytes from 0x3B as big-endian int16 per the datasheet (16384 LSB/g, 131 LSB/(deg/s), temp raw/326.8+25) with WHO_AM_I 0x19; the module is marked cabled because it has a Grove socket rather than header pins.
breakoutPinoutSource: https://docs.m5stack.com/en/unit/imu (pin map GND/5V/SDA/SCL, black/red/yellow/white) and schematic https://static-cdn.m5stack.com/resource/docs/products/unit/imu/imu_sch_01.webp (HT7533 LDO, BSS138 level shifters, 4.7k pull-ups, AD0 to GND)
